# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.
Tests call it in-process; there is no network. Every method returns a pair
`(status, body)`, where `status` is an HTTP-style integer and `body` is a
`dict`, a `list`, or `None`.

    class Service:
        def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600): ...
        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.

- **Idempotency:** each `(user, key)` pair gets one internal gateway reference that is reused on every retry. A timed-out attempt stays "pending" with its amount, so a retry with the same amount completes the payment and a different amount gets 409.

import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_CHARS = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}          # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}         # token -> {"user", "created", "revoked"}
        self._docs = {}           # doc_id -> {"doc": dict, "seq": int}
        self._user_docs = {}      # username -> {doc_id: rec} in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}        # cursor -> (owner, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}       # username -> [payment dict]
        self._attempts = {}       # (username, key) -> attempt record
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(password, salt):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 10000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or rec["revoked"]:
            return None
        if not (self._clock.now() < rec["created"] + self._ttl):
            return None
        return rec["user"]

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        return 1 <= len(title) <= 200 and len(content) <= 100000

    def _own_doc(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        rec = self._user_docs.get(user, {}).get(doc_id)
        return rec

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 400, None
            if not (3 <= len(username) <= 32) or not set(username) <= _USERNAME_CHARS:
                return 400, None
            if len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = {}
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            while token in self._tokens:
                token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = {"user": username, "created": self._clock.now(),
                                   "revoked": False}
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._tokens[token]["revoked"] = True
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            doc = {"id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                   "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            rec = {"doc": doc, "seq": self._doc_counter}
            self._docs[doc_id] = rec
            self._user_docs[user][doc_id] = rec
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            rec["doc"]["title"] = title
            rec["doc"]["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._user_docs[user][doc_id]
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                info = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if info is None or info[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = info[1]
            remaining = [r for r in self._user_docs[user].values() if r["seq"] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                while next_cursor in self._cursors:
                    next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, page[-1]["seq"])
            return 200, {"items": [dict(r["doc"]) for r in page],
                         "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for r in self._user_docs[user].values():
                d = r["doc"]
                if q in d["title"].lower() or q in d["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(d))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(r["doc"]) for r in self._user_docs[user].values()]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            akey = (user, idempotency_key)
            att = self._attempts.get(akey)
            if att is None:
                self._pay_counter += 1
                att = {"amount": amount_cents, "ref": "pay-ref-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                       "payment": None}
                self._attempts[akey] = att
            elif att["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif att["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(att["payment"])
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(att["ref"], amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            payment = {"id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter if False else att["ref"],
                       "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                       "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                       "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            att["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]

        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.

class FakeClock:

class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference. mode: None | 'before' | 'after'."""

    def __init__(self):

        if self.mode == "before":

        if reference not in self.charges:

import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_CHARS = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}          # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}         # token -> {"user", "created", "revoked"}
        self._docs = {}           # doc_id -> {"doc": dict, "seq": int}
        self._user_docs = {}      # username -> {doc_id: rec} in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}        # cursor -> (owner, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}       # username -> [payment dict]
        self._attempts = {}       # (username, key) -> attempt record
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(password, salt):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 10000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or rec["revoked"]:
            return None
        if not (self._clock.now() < rec["created"] + self._ttl):
            return None
        return rec["user"]

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        return 1 <= len(title) <= 200 and len(content) <= 100000

    def _own_doc(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        return self._user_docs.get(user, {}).get(doc_id)

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 400, None
            if not (3 <= len(username) <= 32) or not set(username) <= _USERNAME_CHARS:
                return 400, None
            if len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = {}
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            while token in self._tokens:

import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_CHARS = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}          # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}         # token -> {"user", "created", "revoked"}
        self._docs = {}           # doc_id -> {"doc": dict, "seq": int}
        self._user_docs = {}      # username -> {doc_id: rec} in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}        # cursor -> (owner, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}       # username -> [payment dict]
        self._attempts = {}       # (username, key) -> attempt record
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(password, salt):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 10000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or rec["revoked"]:
            return None
        if not (self._clock.now() < rec["created"] + self._ttl):
            return None
        return rec["user"]

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        return 1 <= len(title) <= 200 and len(content) <= 100000

    def _own_doc(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        return self._user_docs.get(user, {}).get(doc_id)

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 400, None
            if not (3 <= len(username) <= 32) or not set(username) <= _USERNAME_CHARS:
                return 400, None
            if len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = {}
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            while token in self._tokens:
                token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = {"user": username, "created": self._clock.now(),
                                   "revoked": False}
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._tokens[token]["revoked"] = True
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            doc = {"id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                   "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            rec = {"doc": doc, "seq": self._doc_counter}
            self._docs[doc_id] = rec
            self._user_docs[user][doc_id] = rec
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            rec["doc"]["title"] = title
            rec["doc"]["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._user_docs[user][doc_id]
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                info = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if info is None or info[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = info[1]
            remaining = [r for r in self._user_docs[user].values() if r["seq"] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                while next_cursor in self._cursors:
                    next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, page[-1]["seq"])
            return 200, {"items": [dict(r["doc"]) for r in page],
                         "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for r in self._user_docs[user].values():
                d = r["doc"]
                if q in d["title"].lower() or q in d["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(d))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(r["doc"]) for r in self._user_docs[user].values()]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            akey = (user, idempotency_key)
            att = self._attempts.get(akey)
            if att is None:
                self._pay_counter += 1
                att = {"amount": amount_cents, "ref": "pay-ref-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                       "payment": None}
                self._attempts[akey] = att
            elif att["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif att["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(att["payment"])
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(att["ref"], amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            payment = {"id": att["ref"],
                       "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                       "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                       "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            att["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]

        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.

import hmac
import os
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_CHARS = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}          # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}         # token -> {"user", "created", "revoked"}
        self._docs = {}           # doc_id -> {"doc": dict, "seq": int}
        self._user_docs = {}      # username -> {doc_id: rec} in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}        # cursor -> (owner, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}       # username -> [payment dict]
        self._attempts = {}       # (username, key) -> attempt record
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(password, salt):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 10000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or rec["revoked"]:
            return None
        if not (self._clock.now() < rec["created"] + self._ttl):
            return None
        return rec["user"]

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        return 1 <= len(title) <= 200 and len(content) <= 100000

    def _own_doc(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        rec = self._user_docs.get(user, {}).get(doc_id)
        return rec

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 400, None
            if not (3 <= len(username) <= 32) or not set(username) <= _USERNAME_CHARS:
                return 400, None
            if len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = {}
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            while token in self._tokens:
                token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = {"user": username, "created": self._clock.now(),
                                   "revoked": False}
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._tokens[token]["revoked"] = True
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            doc = {"id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                   "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            rec = {"doc": doc, "seq": self._doc_counter}
            self._docs[doc_id] = rec
            self._user_docs[user][doc_id] = rec
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            rec["doc"]["title"] = title
            rec["doc"]["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._user_docs[user][doc_id]
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                info = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if info is None or info[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = info[1]
            remaining = [r for r in self._user_docs[user].values() if r["seq"] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                while next_cursor in self._cursors:
                    next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, page[-1]["seq"])
            return 200, {"items": [dict(r["doc"]) for r in page],
                         "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for r in self._user_docs[user].values():
                d = r["doc"]
                if q in d["title"].lower() or q in d["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(d))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(r["doc"]) for r in self._user_docs[user].values()]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            akey = (user, idempotency_key)
            att = self._attempts.get(akey)
            if att is None:
                self._pay_counter += 1
                att = {"amount": amount_cents, "ref": "pay-ref-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                       "payment": None}
                self._attempts[akey] = att
            elif att["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif att["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(att["payment"])
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(att["ref"], amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            payment = {"id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter if False else att["ref"],
                       "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                       "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                       "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            att["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]

class FakeClock:

class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can time out before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}      # reference -> amount
        self.calls = []
        self.script = []       # list of None | "before" | "after"
        self.always = None

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode = self.always
        if mode is None and self.script:
            mode = self.script.pop(0)
        if mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(
    n=st.integers(0, 25),
    page_size=st.integers(1, 8),
    rounds=st.lists(
        st.tuples(st.lists(st.integers(0, 60), max_size=4), st.integers(0, 3)),
        min_size=0, max_size=12),
)
def test_pagination_interleaved_with_mutations_property(n, page_size, rounds):
    """Following cursors returns every never-deleted document exactly once, in creation order, never a deleted one."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user_token(svc)
    created = []     # ids in creation order
    alive = set()
    for i in range(n):
        d = new_doc(svc, tok, "d%d" % i)
        created.append(d)
        alive.add(d)
    ever_deleted = set()
    returned = []
    cursor = None
    r = 0
    for _ in range(1000):
        s, page = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=page_size, cursor=cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(page_size, cursor)!r} output={(s, page)!r}"
        assert len(page["items"]) <= page_size, f"output={page!r}"
        for d in page["items"]:
            assert d["id"] in alive, f"deleted/unknown doc returned: {d!r} alive={alive!r}"
            returned.append(d["id"])
        cursor = page["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
        if r < len(rounds):
            dels, creates = rounds[r]
            r += 1
            for di in dels:
                if created:
                    target = created[di % len(created)]
                    out = svc.delete_document(tok, target)
                    if target in alive:
                        assert out[0] == 204, f"input={target!r} output={out!r}"
                        alive.discard(target)
                        ever_deleted.add(target)
                    else:
                        assert out[0] == 404, f"input={target!r} output={out!r}"
            for _c in range(creates):
                d = new_doc(svc, tok, "late")
                created.append(d)
                alive.add(d)
    else:
        pytest.fail("pagination did not terminate")
    assert len(returned) == len(set(returned)), f"duplicates in {returned!r}"
    order = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(created)}
    assert returned == sorted(returned, key=order.get), f"not in creation order: {returned!r}"
    missing = alive - set(returned)
    assert not missing, f"skipped documents {missing!r}, returned={returned!r}"

def test_idempotency_under_random_timeouts_property(amounts, attempts):

import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_CHARS = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}          # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}         # token -> {"user", "created", "revoked"}
        self._docs = {}           # doc_id -> {"doc": dict, "seq": int}
        self._user_docs = {}      # username -> {doc_id: rec} in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}        # cursor -> (owner, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}       # username -> [payment dict]
        self._attempts = {}       # (username, key) -> attempt record
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(password, salt):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 10000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        rec = self._tokens.get(token)
        if rec is None or rec["revoked"]:
            return None
        if not (self._clock.now() < rec["created"] + self._ttl):
            return None
        return rec["user"]

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        return 1 <= len(title) <= 200 and len(content) <= 100000

    def _own_doc(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        rec = self._user_docs.get(user, {}).get(doc_id)
        return rec

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 400, None
            if not (3 <= len(username) <= 32) or not set(username) <= _USERNAME_CHARS:
                return 400, None
            if len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = {}
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            while token in self._tokens:
                token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = {"user": username, "created": self._clock.now(),
                                   "revoked": False}
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._tokens[token]["revoked"] = True
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            doc = {"id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                   "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            rec = {"doc": doc, "seq": self._doc_counter}
            self._docs[doc_id] = rec
            self._user_docs[user][doc_id] = rec
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            rec["doc"]["title"] = title
            rec["doc"]["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._user_docs[user][doc_id]
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                info = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if info is None or info[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = info[1]
            remaining = [r for r in self._user_docs[user].values() if r["seq"] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                while next_cursor in self._cursors:
                    next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, page[-1]["seq"])
            return 200, {"items": [dict(r["doc"]) for r in page],
                         "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for r in self._user_docs[user].values():
                d = r["doc"]
                if q in d["title"].lower() or q in d["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(d))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(r["doc"]) for r in self._user_docs[user].values()]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            akey = (user, idempotency_key)
            att = self._attempts.get(akey)
            if att is None:
                self._pay_counter += 1
                att = {"amount": amount_cents, "ref": "pay-ref-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                       "payment": None}
                self._attempts[akey] = att
            elif att["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif att["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(att["payment"])
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(att["ref"], amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            payment = {"id": att["ref"],
                       "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                       "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                       "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            att["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]

        if rec is None or rec["revoked"]:
            return None
        if not (self._clock.now() < rec["created"] + self._ttl):
            return None
        return rec["user"]

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        return 1 <= len(title) <= 200 and len(content) <= 100000

    def _own_doc(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        rec = self._user_docs.get(user, {}).get(doc_id)
        return rec

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 400, None
            if not (3 <= len(username) <= 32) or not set(username) <= _USERNAME_CHARS:
                return 400, None
            if len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = os.urandom(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(password, salt))
            self._user_docs[username] = {}
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(password, salt)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            while token in self._tokens:
                token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = {"user": username, "created": self._clock.now(),
                                   "revoked": False}
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            self._tokens[token]["revoked"] = True
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            doc = {"id": doc_id, "owner": user, "title": title,
                   "content": content, "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            rec = {"doc": doc, "seq": self._doc_counter}
            self._docs[doc_id] = rec
            self._user_docs[user][doc_id] = rec
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            rec["doc"]["title"] = title
            rec["doc"]["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(rec["doc"])

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            rec = self._own_doc(user, doc_id)
            if rec is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._user_docs[user][doc_id]
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                info = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if info is None or info[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = info[1]
            remaining = [r for r in self._user_docs[user].values() if r["seq"] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                while next_cursor in self._cursors:
                    next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, page[-1]["seq"])
            return 200, {"items": [dict(r["doc"]) for r in page],
                         "next_cursor": next_cursor}

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.lower()
            out = []
            for r in self._user_docs[user].values():
                d = r["doc"]
                if q in d["title"].lower() or q in d["content"].lower():
                    out.append(dict(d))
            return 200, out

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(r["doc"]) for r in self._user_docs[user].values()]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            akey = (user, idempotency_key)
            att = self._attempts.get(akey)
            if att is None:
                self._pay_counter += 1
                att = {"amount": amount_cents, "ref": "pay-ref-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                       "payment": None}
                self._attempts[akey] = att
            elif att["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif att["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(att["payment"])
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(att["ref"], amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            payment = {"id": att["ref"],
                       "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                       "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                       "created_at": self._clock.now()}
            att["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]

def mkdoc(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    r = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert r[0] == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={r!r}"
    return r[1]["id"]


def ids(docs):
    return [d["id"] for d in docs]


def collect_pages(svc, tok, ps, limit=500):
    """Follow cursors from the first page; return (items, pages)."""
    items, pages, cursor = [], [], None
    for _ in range(limit):
        r = svc.list_documents(tok, ps, cursor)
        assert r[0] == 200, f"input={(ps, cursor)!r} output={r!r}"
        pages.append(r[1])
        items.extend(r[1]["items"])
        cursor = r[1]["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return items, pages
    raise AssertionError(f"cursor chain did not terminate, ps={ps!r}")

def _all_calls(svc, tok, doc_id):
    return {
        "logout": svc.logout(tok),
        "create": svc.create_document(tok, "new", "doc"),
        "get": svc.get_document(tok, doc_id),
        "update": svc.update_document(tok, doc_id, "changed", "changed"),
        "delete": svc.delete_document(tok, doc_id),
        "list": svc.list_documents(tok),
        "search": svc.search_documents(tok, "orig"),
        "export": svc.export_documents(tok),
        "pay": svc.pay(tok, 100, "bad-token-key"),
        "payments": svc.list_payments(tok),
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["none", "empty", "unknown", "expired", "revoked"])
def test_every_method_rejects_invalid_tokens_with_401(kind):
    """Every method taking a token must return 401 and have no effect for a missing, unknown, expired or revoked token."""
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl=10)
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    main = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    expired = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    revoked = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(revoked)[0] == 204
    d = mkdoc(svc, main, "orig", "orig")
    tok = {"none": None, "empty": "", "unknown": "not-a-real-token",
           "expired": expired, "revoked": revoked}[kind]
    if kind == "expired":
        clock.advance(10.0)
    results = _all_calls(svc, tok, d)
    for name, r in results.items():
        assert r[0] == 401, f"kind={kind!r} method={name} output={r!r}"
    fresh = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    g = svc.get_document(fresh, d)
    assert g[0] == 200 and g[1]["title"] == "orig" and g[1]["content"] == "orig", f"output={g!r}"
    e = svc.export_documents(fresh)
    assert e[0] == 200 and ids(e[1]) == [d], f"output={e!r}"
    p = svc.list_payments(fresh)
    assert p == (200, []), f"output={p!r}"
    assert gw.charged == {}, f"charged={gw.charged!r}"

def test_foreign_document_is_indistinguishable_from_missing():
    """A request by A on a document of B must return 404 like a missing document and must not change it."""

    for name, call in (
        ("get", lambda i: svc.get_document(a, i)),
        ("update", lambda i: svc.update_document(a, i, "hacked", "hacked")),
        ("delete", lambda i: svc.delete_document(a, i)),
    ):
        r_foreign = call(d)

        assert r_foreign[0] == 404, f"method={name} output={r_foreign!r}"
        assert r_missing[0] == 404, f"method={name} output={r_missing!r}"
        assert "secret" not in repr(r_foreign), f"method={name} output={r_foreign!r}"

class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; script items are consumed per call."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.script = []      # "ok" | "timeout_before" | "timeout_after"
        self.charged = {}     # reference -> amount
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        action = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else "ok"
        if action == "timeout_before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if action == "timeout_after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

def ids(docs):
    return [d["id"] for d in docs]


def collect_pages(svc, tok, ps, limit=500):
    """Follow cursors from the first page; return (items, pages)."""
    items, pages, cursor = [], [], None
    for _ in range(limit):
        r = svc.list_documents(tok, ps, cursor)
        assert r[0] == 200, f"input={(ps, cursor)!r} output={r!r}"
        pages.append(r[1])
        items.extend(r[1]["items"])
        cursor = r[1]["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return items, pages
    raise AssertionError(f"cursor chain did not terminate, ps={ps!r}")

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["none", "empty", "unknown", "expired", "revoked"])
def test_every_method_rejects_invalid_tokens_with_401(kind):
    """Every method taking a token must return 401 and have no effect for a missing, unknown, expired or revoked token."""
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl=10)
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    main = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]

    d = mkdoc(svc, main, "orig", "orig")
    tok = {"none": None, "empty": "", "unknown": "not-a-real-token",
           "expired": expired, "revoked": revoked}[kind]
    if kind == "expired":
        clock.advance(10.0)
    results = _all_calls(svc, tok, d)
    for name, r in results.items():
        assert r[0] == 401, f"kind={kind!r} method={name} output={r!r}"
    fresh = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    g = svc.get_document(fresh, d)
    assert g[0] == 200 and g[1]["title"] == "orig" and g[1]["content"] == "orig", f"output={g!r}"
    e = svc.export_documents(fresh)
    assert e[0] == 200 and ids(e[1]) == [d], f"output={e!r}"
    p = svc.list_payments(fresh)
    assert p == (200, []), f"output={p!r}"
    assert gw.charged == {}, f"charged={gw.charged!r}"

def test_pagination_against_model_with_interleaved_mutations(ops, ps):
    """Cursor paging must return remaining documents created after the last returned one, without duplicates or skips, under interleaved creates and deletes."""
    svc, _, _ = make()

    b = signup(svc, "bobby")

        elif op == "create_other":

            remaining = [i for i in order[pos + 1:] if i in alive]
            expected = remaining[:ps]
            assert ids(r[1]["items"]) == expected, \
                f"input={ops!r} ps={ps} expected={expected!r} output={r!r}"
            nc = r[1]["next_cursor"]

                assert nc is None, f"input={ops!r} output={r!r}"
            if nc is None:

                cursor, pos = None, -1

                cursor, pos = nc, order.index(expected[-1])

# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.
Tests call it in-process; there is no network. Every method returns a pair
`(status, body)`, where `status` is an HTTP-style integer and `body` is a
`dict`, a `list`, or `None`.

    class Service:
        def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600): ...
        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.
